data.name: Tales Of Epitome
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of Epitome and prepare for an adrenaline-fueled, Third-Person Action RPG experience that blends hack-and-slash combat with platforming challenges and arcade-style horde killing!

A new era of Unity through fear threatens to rise, led by hordes of nightmare creatures. You start as the central hero, embarking on a quest to combat this terrifying darkness.

Key Features:

  • A Journey of Eight: Begin as the main protagonist and, as you progress, encounter and acquire seven unique playable characters throughout the stylized, medium-sized open world.

  • Real-Time Combat Mastery: Switch seamlessly between your main character and your growing roster of companions mid-combat, in real-time! Master the art of the quick-switch to chain together sick, devastating combos against your foes.

  • The Castle Hub: Your journey begins at a central Castle Hub. From here, you can venture out into the open world or dive into accessible instanced levels to progress the main story.

  • Hopes, Dreams, and Nightmares: Defeat enemies and literally "eat" their hopes and dreams. Harness the hopes within their dreams or the fears within their nightmares to unlock powerful, distinct new abilities and transform your playstyle.

  • Arcade Spectacle: Battle and collect mysterious crystals to unlock new areas and delve deeper into the secrets of Epitome.

  • Expand Your Battleground: Challenge friends or rivals in dedicated 1v1 and 2v2 Arena modes featuring global leaderboards.

  • Local Co-op: Bring a friend into the fight with Couch Co-op support!

Fight your way through the nightmare. Harness the power of hopes and dreams. The destiny of Epitome is in your hands!

data.short_description: Arcade Horde-Killing Hack and Slash RPG with Platforming! Devour the hopes and dreams of foes for powerful new abilities. Acquire 7 allies, explore a stylized open world, collect crystals, and master real-time mid-combat character-switching combos. Play co-op or rise on the global leaderboards!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster (e.g., Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible card with 4 GB VRAM (e.g., GTX 1060 / RX 580)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (Latest Version)
  • Processor: Six-core Intel or AMD, 3.4 GHz or faster (e.g., Core i7-12700K / Ryzen 7 5800X3D)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible card with 8 GB+ VRAM (e.g., RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: When I say violence I mean OG God Of War hack and slash type gameplay
